derives_from.Q7_Q8: process identity = (PID, starttime); starttime from /proc/<pid>/stat field 22, parsed relative to the LAST ')'. SC_CLK_TCK = 100.
derives_from.Q3: sessionNonce is per X PROCESS (getrandom once, never re-rolled); generation is per Activity SHARE, 1-based, monotonic.
derives_from.Q2_F2: (nonce, generation) CANNOT distinguish 'same X, new Activity' from 'same X, same Activity, new generation', because the nonce is per X process and only the generation advances.
derives_from.D_02: epoch_id is a renderer-process-local counter, independent of epoch_generation.

x_process.changes_when: a new X server process starts
x_process.note: REQUIRED on both sides of every generation boundary. PID alone is FORBIDDEN (Q7).

activity_process.note: This is THE discriminator between WARM and COLD. Neither the tuple nor the epoch_id can substitute for it (Q2-F2).

generation_tuple.changes_when: sessionNonce: only on a NEW X process. generation: on every lorieActivityConnected()

renderer_latched_tuple.source: renderer-process-local latch, taken only on EVENT_SHARED_SERVER_STATE
renderer_latched_tuple.changes_when: the renderer latches a new tuple
renderer_latched_tuple.note: Q3 proved the renderer admits against THIS, never the shared field. A lag between the two authorities is the failure mode, so BOTH must be recorded at every boundary.

epoch_id.changes_when: the renderer latches a genuinely different tuple
epoch_id.note: Counts what THIS renderer process has seen. Deliberately independent of generation, because generation cannot express an Activity boundary.

requires: activity_process UNCHANGED across the boundary (same pid AND same starttime)
x_process CHANGED (new pid, or same pid with a different starttime)
WARM.forbidden_proof: the launch method. §8.4: 'must not use "we started it this way" as proof'.

requires: activity_process CHANGED (different pid OR different starttime)
epoch_id RESET to 1 (a new renderer process starts its counter at 0)
COLD.note: V-8: the notification-bar Exit does NOT end the termux-x11 command, so COLD must prove the PROCESS is gone, not that the Activity looks closed.

forbidden: PID alone as process identity (Q7: /proc/sys/kernel/pid_max is unreadable in this PRoot, so the reuse margin cannot even be computed)
(nonce, generation) alone to classify WARM vs COLD (Q2-F2)
epoch_id alone to classify WARM vs COLD (it resets with the renderer process, so a COLD restart and a fresh first epoch are indistinguishable by it)
inferring generationFatal state after a re-share bump: lorieGateAProtocolInit clears it (Q3), so absence proves nothing
treating a missing renderer END as a failure without first checking whether TERMINATE was sent (D-02: the END is gated on explicit whole-run finalization)

rationale.x_fd_table_had_previous_conn_fd: Q9-F1: getXConnection neither closes nor unregisters the previous fd, so two fds can be registered at once. Nothing in the product reports this; it must come from /proc/<x_pid>/fd at the boundary.
